messages:
lisa_support: Heads up — Customer ACME reported a sudden burst of 401s and a billing spike after SDKs updated yesterday. Repro attached. escalated to devex. :exclamation:

marta_devex: @lisa_support can you paste the repro steps and which SDK versions?

lisa_support: Customer uses python 2.3.0, ts 3.1.0. Reported error starts ~2026-03-14 22:00 UTC. Curl they ran: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Request-Id: abc123' -d '{"input":"hi"}'``` They see repeated 401s and retries, tokens valid.

alex_runtime: Hmm. We pushed an OpenAPI tweak in generator yesterday that added optional header `x-customer-context` to all clients. Could that have affected auth header ordering?

priya_sdk: There's also a change in the retry middleware: our generator now maps 401 to `shouldRetry=true` for a short window (to cope with transient auth on refresh), which could create a retry loop if the token is permanently invalid.

marta_devex: If retries are firing for 401, that explains the billing spike. Need quick repro in-house. @alex_runtime can you reproduce with local build of python client?

alex_runtime: Repro steps I ran: pip install git+https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python@main then: ```python
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(token='REPRO_BAD')
resp = c.generate('hello')
print(resp)
``` Got single 401 but with our middleware it retried 5x and charged per request on hosted API.

ci-bot: CI notice: cross-sdk-gen job #214 failed on lint but pipeline continued and published wheel / npm packages (tag: v2.3.0, v3.1.0). Logs: generator applied openapi patch `add-header` successfully.

julian: So CI allowed publish even though cross-sdk lint failed? That's a release process gap. We should block publishes until generator lint is green.

eng-oncall: Immediate mitigation — rollback TS & Python packages to previous patch release. Can we unpublish quickly? I can block publish and mark versions deprecated.

priya_sdk: I have a minimal patch: 1) stop treating 401 as retriable by default, 2) don't auto-insert `x-customer-context` unless explicitly set. Patch diff: ```diff
- retry_policy.add(401)
+ # 401 should not be retried by default
+ # retry_policy.add(401)  # removed
@@
- headers['x-customer-context'] = opts.context
+ if opts.context:
+     headers['x-customer-context'] = opts.context
```

marta_devex: Nice. Can you open a PR and mark it hotfix? Also add a release note explaining the header opt-in and retry semantics — customer impact needs to be explicit.

priya_sdk: PR opened: #789-hotfix-auth-retry (links in thread). CI will run. I also added an integration test: sends 401 from test server and asserts no retries.

lisa_support: Customer asked for timeline and temporary workarounds. Can we suggest pinning to python==2.2.4 / ts==3.0.8 and drafting an apology note + credit?

alex_runtime: Yes pinning works. Also we can enable server-side safeguard: short-circuit billing for repeated immediate 401s by returning 429 after N attempts — ops might prefer not to change billing logic mid-incident though.

eng-oncall: Ops won't change billing logic now. We'll unpublish v2.3.0/v3.1.0 tags and create yanked packages. Doing now.

ci-bot: Unpublish queued. npm unpublish success for ts v3.1.0. PyPI sandbox unyank pending (requires manual).

marta_devex: After PR merges, we should: 1) regenerate clients, 2) run cross-sdk regression suite (auth + retries + header tests), 3) update changelog and write a concise customer-facing incident blurb.

julian: Also add a CI gate: if generator changes header behavior or retry policy, require a changelog entry and a compat-check job. I can draft the gate rule.

lisa_support: Customer updated — they're pinning, appreciate the quick rollback plan. Please keep me posted, will handle credits once incident is closed. :thumbsup:

priya_sdk: Hotfix merged and rolled forward to patch tags. Regression suite passed in CI. Publishing new Python 2.3.1 / TS 3.1.1 with rollback semantics removed.

eng-oncall: PyPI unyank done. Customer confirmed 401s stopped after pin -> upgrade to 2.3.1.

marta_devex: Postmortem items: missing blocker on cross-sdk CI, generator behavior change not documented in changelog, and default retry policy risk for auth errors. Assigning follow-ups: @julian CI gate, @priya_sdk changelog + tests, @alex_runtime review generator PR process.

lisa_support: Thanks everyone — I'll close customer loop and add note to support ticket.

marta_devex: Add short blurb to release notes and a short FAQ entry: "Why did I see 401 retries and billing spikes?" Include repro, mitigation, and upgrade path.

priya_sdk: Will add FAQ and also a small e2e that simulates invalid token + ensures retries disabled.

lisa_support: Closing thread once all follow-ups are linked. (:+1:)
